annotations.title: Cards in a set with prices

description: Use this when the user wants the most valuable cards in a specific set or a priced checklist of a set. Requires a set id from list_sets. Returns raw and PSA 10 USD prices per card. Do not use for a single named card; use search_cards instead.

game.description: Game or sport the set belongs to, e.g. "pokemon" or "basketball". Use the same value you passed to list_sets.

limit.description: How many cards to return in the chosen order (1 to 100, default 25). total_cards in the result gives the full set size.

name: get_set_cards

id.description: Catalog card id. Pass to get_card_prices, grading_roi or get_price_history.

url.description: Card page with the full price ladder and history

title: Cards in a set with prices
